_comment: Card id -> Cardmarket product id, hand-checked. Wins over every source and still goes through the catalog check (the product must exist); the name check is bypassed for entries here, which is the point: these are the cards the two sides name differently. Keep the reason next to each one, and only add a card whose whole expansion otherwise validates (a lone mismatch in a shifted expansion is a wrong id, not a spelling).
_3-10: Lorcana. Lorcast 'Miss Bianca - Rescue Aid Society Agent' = Cardmarket 'Miss Bianca - International Rescue Aid Society Agent' (Into the Inklands 10/204); LorcanaJSON publishes this id
_7-103: Lorcana. Lorcast 'Tweedledee & Tweedledum' = Cardmarket 'Tweedle Dee & Tweedle Dum' (Archazia's Island 103/204); LorcanaJSON publishes this id
_panorama: Lorcana, Reign of Jafar: the five Panorama printings (foil-only second print of a card, own artwork, own TCGplayer id). Lorcast numbers them '1f'; LorcanaJSON does not list them; CardTrader has them as '001p' with version 'Panorama', one Cardmarket id each (the set's 'V2' products, 2026-10-07). Not the base card's product: Louie V1 trends 0.04 / 3.61 foil, V2 0.02 / 1.91.
_8-1f: Lorcana. 'Louie - One Cool Duck' Panorama = CardTrader 332002 (001p)
_8-3f: Lorcana. 'Huey - Reliable Leader' Panorama = CardTrader blueprint 003p
_8-65f: Lorcana. 'Nero - Fearsome Crocodile' Panorama = CardTrader blueprint 065p
_base1-73: Pokémon. TCGdex 'Impostor Professor Oak' = Cardmarket 'Imposter Professor Oak' (Base Set 73/102); 101/102 of the set validate on this TCGdex id range
_base4-102: Pokémon. Same spelling difference, Base Set 2 102/130; 129/130 of the set validate
_ex6-98: Pokémon. TCGdex 'Prof. Oak's Research' = Cardmarket 'Professor Oak's Research' (FireRed & LeafGreen 98/112); 115/116 of the set validate
_ogs-017-024: Riftbound. The official gallery names the Proving Grounds starter legends by title only ('Dark Child - Starter'); Cardmarket says 'Annie, Dark Child'. Same card, OGS-017/024; CardTrader blueprint cm 847539
_ogs-019-024: Riftbound. 'Wuju Bladesman - Starter' = 'Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman', OGS-019/024
_ogs-021-024: Riftbound. 'Lady of Luminosity - Starter' = 'Lux, Lady of Luminosity', OGS-021/024
_ogs-023-024: Riftbound. 'Might of Demacia - Starter' = 'Garen, Might of Demacia', OGS-023/024
